command.mxt_test.guide.1: Qingxiao Trial: 1. Run /mxt_test kit to receive the identity, resources, and tools.
command.mxt_test.guide.2: 2. Hold a Qingxiao Spirit Crystal and run /mxt_test cultivate. Then use /mxt breakthrough mxt_test:qi to test advancement.
command.mxt_test.guide.3: 3. Use the formation plate on a gold block, bind a wolf with the contract scroll, and enter the End trial using the realm token.
command.mxt_test.guide.4: 4. Use /mxt ability cast mxt_test:qingxiao_firebolt, /mxt_test task, and /mxt sect claim to test abilities, sects, and territory.
